negative_findings.description: Ziraat Bank Montenegro's Serbian homepage (ziraatbank.me/sr) as fetched exposes only 'obavještenja' (notices, tariffs, general terms) and no navigation link to a financial-reports or objelodanjivanje section; the annual-reports page was only reachable via a site-scoped search engine query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep page https://www.ziraatbank.me/sr/godisnji-izvjestaji exists per search index but is not discoverable from the homepage fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A homepage-only crawler would score Ziraat as a non-disclosing bank, which is wrong. Deep-link seeds are required per bank.

negative_findings.description: https://www.ckb.me/about-us/welcome-to-ckb/reports failed with a TLS error ('unable to verify the first certificate'), and https://www.hipotekarnabanka.com/izvjestaji/javno-objelodanjivanje-podataka returned HTTP 404 while the parent https://www.hipotekarnabanka.com/izvjestaji/ fetched cleanly and lists the disclosure documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are hypotheses, not verdicts: CKB is presumed live behind a broken cert chain; the Hipotekarna disclosure sub-path has most likely moved into the consolidated /izvjestaji/ listing (site appears to have migrated to WordPress).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recording these as dead would drop the two largest domestic disclosure archives from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: Searches using the Basel term 'Stub 3' / 'Pillar 3' in Serbian returned no Montenegrin bank hits.
negative_findings.result_summary: Montenegrin banks label prudential disclosures 'javno objelodanjivanje podataka' or 'javno objavljivanje podataka' (Art. 237, Zakon o kreditnim institucijama), not Pillar 3/Stub 3.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query sets built on Basel vocabulary will systematically miss ME prudential disclosures; the two spelling variants (objelodanjivanje vs objavljivanje) must both be used.

negative_findings.description: A combined multi-bank query for 2025 disclosures (Universal Capital, Adriatic, Lovćen, Ziraat) returned only generic Montenegrin open-data and freedom-of-information results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multi-actor queries dilute; per-bank site-scoped queries were required and worked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the query design rule for the collection routine: one bank per query, local-language term + domain.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegrin bank in this cell was observed to operate an 'Investor Relations' section in the Western sense (IR calendar, earnings call, analyst deck, IR contact).
negative_findings.result_summary: Disclosure is statutory-document publication under 'O nama', 'Izvještaji', 'Mediji i publikacije' or 'Odnosi sa javnošću' — not an IR function.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Searching 'investor relations' in English will under-recover this market; navigate by 'izvještaji', 'o nama', 'odnosi sa javnošću' instead. No earnings-call transcripts should be expected as a source type.

coverage_gaps.description: Of the 11 licensed banks in the CBCG register, a self-published reports page was located for 10 (CKB, Hipotekarna, Erste, NLB, Addiko, Prva, Lovćen, Adriatic, Universal Capital, Zapad, Ziraat). No page-level verification was done for any bank's full year-depth, and no scouting was done for banks in liquidation/wind-down or for branches of foreign banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-bank deep-link pass (one bank per query, Serbian terms + site: scoping) and record the canonical reports URL, earliest available year, and PDF path pattern for each of the 11 registered banks; re-run against the register monthly to catch licence changes.

coverage_gaps.description: General assembly / skupština akcionara materials (agendas, decisions, dividend and capital resolutions) were only confirmed for Hipotekarna banka. Other banks' assembly notices were not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search per bank for 'poziv za sjednicu Skupštine akcionara', 'odluke Skupštine akcionara', 'obavještenje akcionarima', and cross-check the Montenegro securities market issuer pages (scmn.me) which may carry filings the banks omit.

coverage_gaps.description: Almost all primary documents are Serbian/Montenegrin only; English versions are sporadic (Erste: one 2015 report; NLB and UCB and Adriatic have partial EN locales). Some Erste documents were described as Cyrillic script while most Montenegrin material is Latin.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for sr-Latn plus occasional sr-Cyrl OCR/normalisation in the parsing layer; do not rely on EN mirrors for time-series continuity, and store the local-language document as the canonical artefact.

coverage_gaps.description: Year-depth per bank site is uneven and only partly observed (Hipotekarna 2007+, Erste 2009+, Addiko 2011+, Ziraat 2015+, NLB visibly only 2022+ before 'Show more' expansion). JS accordions may hide older years from a plain HTTP crawl.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use a JS-capable fetcher for NLB-style accordions, and backfill missing years from the CBCG per-bank archive whose PDF paths are enumerable by year and bank code.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-issued press-release / news channels were confirmed only for Universal Capital and Hipotekarna in this pass, although the topic scope includes press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each of the 11 banks locate the 'Novosti'/'Vijesti'/'Obavještenja'/'Mediji i publikacije' section and register it as a separate source with a monthly cadence, distinct from the statutory-report source.

coverage_gaps.description: robots.txt, ToS and rate-limit posture were not inspected for any bank domain in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before enabling automated collection, fetch robots.txt for ckb.me, hipotekarnabanka.com, erstebank.me, nlb.me, addiko.me, prvabankacg.com, lovcenbanka.me, adriaticbank.com, ucbank.me, zapadbanka.me, ziraatbank.me, cbcg.me and record crawl-delay/disallow rules; treat thebanks.eu as ToS-restricted until checked.

brief: Montenegro's eleven licensed banks all self-publish their statutory disclosure set — audited annual financial statements with an independent auditor's opinion, an annual management report, and quarterly/semi-annual prudential disclosures filed under Article 237 of the Zakon o kreditnim institucijama — but they do so as flat PDF listings under 'Izvještaji' / 'O nama' / 'Odnosi sa javnošću', not through anything resembling a Western investor-relations function; there are no earnings calls, decks or IR calendars to collect. The local vocabulary is decisive: 'javno objelodanjivanje podataka' and its variant 'javno objavljivanje podataka' are the Pillar 3 equivalents, and Basel-style English or 'Stub 3' queries return essentially nothing. Depth and structure vary widely — Hipotekarna, Erste and Addiko offer 15+ year archives with predictable file paths, while NLB hides history behind JS accordions and Ziraat's report page is unreachable from its own homepage — so per-bank deep-link seeds plus the CBCG per-bank financial-statement archive (enumerable as .../fin_izv/god{YYYY}/{bank}_{YYYY}.pdf) should be run as a paired primary-and-fallback collection. Two fetch failures (CKB TLS chain error, one Hipotekarna 404 whose parent listing works) are recorded as unverified hypotheses, not dead sources.
